text:
sam: kicking off model-route-v4 deploy in eu-west, planning a phased FF ramp: 10% -> 50% with a 10m quiet window. can someone own telemetry and rollback thresholds?
maria: noted. i'll monitor latency and 5xx rates.
deploybot: [auto] deploy started svc=route-service version=4.2.0 region=eu-west canary=true
li: propose triggers: p95 < 250ms, error_rate < 0.5%, model_quality_drift < 1% (eval set). if any trigger trips => immediate rollback + pin to v3.
ops: for sticky sessions set cohort.sticky=true during ramp. avoids session splits.
jordan: ready. ff command I'm going to use:
```
/ff toggle model_route_v4 --env=prod --pct=10 --note="canary eu-west"
```
ops-bot: ack — toggle scheduled at 22:10 UTC, sticky=true applied. :white_check_mark:
deploybot: canary results: 200/200 reqs OK, p95=230ms, err=0.2%, cold_cache_activity low. telemetry link: https://telemetry.redwood/test/run/1716161616
anya: looks clean to me. suggested ramp to 50%?
sam: hold for 5m to let caches settle.
maria: +1, watching logs for 5xx and tokenization errors.
(5 minutes pass)
jordan: ramping to 50% now:
```
/ff toggle model_route_v4 --env=prod --pct=50 --note="post-canary ramp"
```
ops-bot: ramp started — routing updated, autoscale check passed.
li: alert: model_quality_drift=1.3% on our prompt eval set (threshold=1.0%). seeing subtle hallucination uptick on safety prompts.
sam: what's the user-visible impact? region scope?
maria: currently most signals from eu-west cohorts but at 50% global we risk leakage. severity moderate. recommend rollback.
ops: recommend soft-drain, pin FF to 0% and mark for immediate rollback.
sam: executing rollback ops:
```
/deploy rollback route-service --to=4.1.8 --reason="model_quality_drift"
/ff toggle model_route_v4 --env=prod --pct=0 --pin=on --note="rollback due to quality drift"
```
deploybot: rollback initiated — draining canary, redirecting traffic to version=4.1.8
deploybot: rollback complete, all traffic on v3. pinned flag model_route_v4=on (0%).
jordan: filing quick postmortem + adding failing prompts to eval suite. link: https://confluence/redwood/pm/model-route-v4-rollback-1716161616
sam: thanks all. follow-up: model re-eval + preflight for v4 fix tomorrow 15:00 UTC. please add any extra telemetry thresholds to that doc. :thumbsup:
